name: Sakamoto Kinpachi
source:
He is the original Japanese Language teacher, but is currently hospitalized. He is the [url=/c129116]protagonist[/url]'s previous teacher and current mentor. He gives teaching advice when visiting him at the hospital.

Based on "Kinpachi-sensei" from the TV series [I][url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生]3 Nen B Gumi Kinpachi-sensei[/url][/I].
